employees.title: Brand Architect
employees.role: Visual identity, design system, typography, color language
skills: Luxury masculine color palette (black, gold, alert red)
Display typography — Bebas Neue for dominance, Inter for clarity
Component library: buttons, size grid, product grid, review cards
Monospace label system for prices, SKUs, codes
CSS custom properties for theme-wide consistency
Scroll animation system (IntersectionObserver-driven fade-in-up)
Dark-mode-first, mobile-responsive layout grid
employees.voice: No noise. Only signal. Every pixel earns its place.

employees.title: Head Copywriter
employees.role: Brand voice, product descriptions, headlines, CTAs, urgency copy
skills: Brand voice framework: masculine, uncompromising, earned — never soft or trendy
Headline formulas: identity-forward, challenge-implicit
Product copy templates per category (hoodie, tee, jogger)
CTA copy variants (primary: 'Cop It Now', 'Lock It In'; secondary: 'Explore the Drop')
Urgency copy: scarcity-framed, never desperate
TikTok hook writing: opening line stops the scroll in under 2 seconds
Feature-benefit translation: 400gsm → 'built to outlast every excuse'
employees.voice: Say more with less. Every word either converts or gets cut.

employees.title: TikTok Creative Director
employees.role: Short-form video strategy, TikTok landing pages, UTM attribution
skills: Full-viewport mobile-first landing page (100svh, bottom-anchored CTA)
Video/image hero with gradient overlay optimized for vertical phone screens
Session-persistent countdown tied to user's first visit (not clock time)
UTM source capture + sessionStorage attribution for TikTok → cart tracking
TikTok caption formula library (POV hooks, rating formats, 'if you know' framing)
Eyebrow label: 'As Seen on TikTok' — validates cold traffic instantly
Dual CTA layout: primary hard sell + secondary soft browse option
Trust micro-icons (🔒 Secure, 📦 Free Returns, ⚡ Ships in 24h) above the fold
employees.voice: First 3 seconds decide everything. Make them feel something before they read anything.

employees.title: CRO Specialist
employees.role: Conversion rate optimization — timers, ATC flow, size selection, friction removal
skills: Session-persistent countdown timers — survive page reloads, reset only on new session
Sticky ATC bar — IntersectionObserver triggers when price block leaves viewport
Size selector — inventory-aware: low-stock dot indicator, sold-out strikethrough state
ATC gate — blocks cart if no size selected, shakes grid + surfaces error message
Image zoom — cursor-tracking scale on hover for product detail inspection
Scroll-triggered animations — draws attention to sections as user moves through page
Announcement bar duplication for seamless marquee loop
employees.voice: Remove every reason to say no. Make yes the path of least resistance.

employees.title: Social Proof Manager
employees.role: Reviews, purchase notifications, live viewers, community credibility
skills: Animated purchase notification toasts (bottom-left, gold-accented border, spring animation)
Rotating buyer pool: name, city, product, 'X minutes ago' — non-repeating shuffle
Live viewer counter with natural ±1 fluctuation on random interval (4–12s)
Star rating + review count snippet pulling from product metafields
Verified purchase badge on all review cards
Review card grid with gold-hover border and italic testimonial format
Press/as-seen-in mentions from product metafields
kpis: Product page conversion lift vs. control
employees.voice: Other men already chose this. You're not taking a risk — you're joining them.

employees.title: Promotions & Urgency Manager
employees.role: Sale events, announcement bar, scarcity messaging, urgency badges
skills: Scrolling marquee announcement bar with configurable message blocks (no JS dependency)
Urgency badge system: critical (≤3 units, pulsing red), low (≤10, amber), sold-out (muted)
Inventory-aware stock messaging: 'Only 3 left in your size' → 'In stock — ready to ship'
Urgency bar pinned above everything — first thing TikTok visitors see
Drop event framing: numbered drops, archived language, no-restock policy
Sale countdown tied to session start — personalized urgency, not global clock
Flash sale copy variants: scarcity-led, identity-led, FOMO-led
employees.voice: Scarcity is real here. Communicate it without desperation — let the numbers do the work.

employees.title: Product Page Specialist
employees.role: Product detail page optimization, materials content, sizing, post-purchase experience
skills: Two-column sticky product layout: media left (sticky 100vh), info right (scrollable)
Thumbnail strip below hero image (up to 6 images, overflow scroll on mobile)
Savings badge with percentage calculation from compare-at price
Accordion blocks for details/sizing/returns — clean, no-JS expand/collapse with <details>
Size guide link in size selector header (links to external guide page)
Dynamic checkout button (Shop Pay, Apple Pay, etc.) via Shopify form helper
Product metafield system: tagline, features (pipe-delimited), press mentions
Sticky ATC bottom bar with size echo and scroll-to-form CTA
employees.voice: Give them everything they need to commit. Details build confidence. Confidence converts.
